tips: Overstood the layline by ~9°. Tack onto it a little sooner and sail the last 100 m at full upwind speed.
Reached off at 151° to the wind for the first 15–40 s after the mark (your best exited at 167°). Bear away all the way to the run angle first, then set.
Took 29 s to settle on the run (best 12 s). Pole and halyard ready on the layline, so the set happens as you bear away.
Lost 80 m (8.6 lengths) on the way in. Drop earlier and set up wide so the turn starts before the mark, not at it.
Tacked 28 s after the mark, so its cost is in this number. Fine if it was for clear air or the favoured side; otherwise hold the lane until you're up to speed.
Passed 53 m (5.7 lengths) from the mark. Wide in, tight out: leave it about a boat length (3 m) away on the exit.
